title: ProteomicsQuantStepConfig
description: DIA-NN / proteomics quant knobs (actionConfig.proteomics_quant). Derived from workers/methyl_worker/diann_runner.py resolve_diann_config and _resolve_reference. threads defaults to 8 when unset (METHYL_DIANN_THREADS default in diann_runner.py). image has no code default (empty env is a hard error).

image.description: DIA-NN Docker image (actionConfig.proteomics_quant.image). Required at runtime unless METHYL_DIANN_IMAGE is set. diann_runner.py.

threads.description: DIA-NN worker threads. Default 8 from os.environ.get('METHYL_DIANN_THREADS', '8') in diann_runner.py.

protein_fasta.description: Protein FASTA. Overrides site proteomics_reference.protein_fasta. diann_runner._resolve_reference.

spectral_library.description: DIA spectral library. Overrides site proteomics_reference.spectral_library. diann_runner._resolve_reference.

prosit_model.description: Copied onto proteomics_quant from site proteomics_reference by site_slice_for_action.

casanovo_model.description: Copied onto proteomics_quant from site proteomics_reference by site_slice_for_action.
